metadata.author: Jaden Cole
metadata.title: Dental Weekly Update — Recovery
metadata.stakeholders: Jaden Cole; Robin Holt; Chris Alvarez
metadata.demo_effect: Narratively closes the loop and shows the product improving after remediation.

payload.summary: Dental is improving from severe risk to managed caution. The vendor provided a phased recovery path, leadership approved staged mitigation, and the team can keep the stakeholder demo alive by pairing partial vendor access with mock services and a narrowed critical-path scope.

decisions.label: capture revised milestone path
decisions.anchorText: Held the vendor recovery call and captured the revised milestone path.

decisions.label: document staged mitigation decision
decisions.anchorText: Closed the cost-impact request and documented the staged mitigation decision.

decisions.label: resolve access for named users
decisions.anchorText: Resolved access for named users to partial sandbox capabilities starting 4/18.

warnings: Full vendor environment access is still pending 4/25, so the product is not fully healthy.
The demo path is safer but still depends on timely integration test harness work.
